content.text: Only one Meera Bhat invoice and exact amount.

input.rationale: Payment of 9,000,000 paise with notes.student "Meera Bhat" exactly equals open invoice INV-00214 (CUST00184, Meera Bhat), issued 2026-09-09, before capture on 2026-09-11. It is the only Meera Bhat invoice and the only invoice at that amount. Meera Shah and Pooja Bhat are different customers with different amounts. No other payments exist for this name.
